description: A short algebraic formula whose exponents are set at 7pt on a baseline raised ~6pt above the 12pt body characters (real superscript positioning, not a synthetic already-grouped block). Word grouping keeps the whole formula on one line, but treats each exponent as its own word separated by a spurious space ('x 2 + y 2 = z 2') instead of attaching it directly to its base ('x2 + y2 = z2') -- Stage 1 has no font-size-aware notion of "this word is a superscript of the previous one".
